turnaround_reason: Digital-engineering / IT-services firm de-rated on the sector-wide 'AI compresses IT services demand' fear despite operationally beating its own guidance. Q2 2026 revenue ~$1B and 9.6% adj EBITDA margin exceeded expectations on strong commercial bookings, federal wins, and the Quinnox integration — but EPS fell 52% YoY, and the stock trades ~6x EV/EBITDA reflecting skepticism margins recover.
bullish_points: Beat guidance on both revenue and EBITDA margin — execution better than the ~7.8x forward multiple implies
Diversifying growth: commercial bookings strength + federal contract wins + Quinnox integration lifting margins/capabilities
Trading right at its 200-day MA (-0.8%) — technically basing rather than falling knife
Cheap on a real, cash-generative services book; positive net margin (~2%) and moderate leverage (D/E ~83%) vs peers
bearish_points: EPS down 52% YoY and net income -52% — earnings power still deteriorating even as revenue holds
Secular AI overhang on IT services is the whole reason it's cheap; multiple may stay compressed regardless of execution
yfinance business summary blank; limited standalone franchise visibility — much of the story rides on integration synergies
'Basing' with no obvious hard catalyst — could sit dead-money for quarters
catalyst: Continued guidance beats showing margins troughing and re-expanding toward late-2025 levels, easing the AI-demand fear discount
suggested_trade: Spot only; modest position on evidence of margin stabilization. No urgency — wait for the next print.
key_risk: AI-driven demand erosion across IT services proves structural, so bookings strength fades and the cheap multiple is deserved
would_skip_if: Bookings momentum reverses or EBITDA margin slips back below high-single digits on the next report.
